message:

hold_reason: Unresolved refund failure: order 103, amount_cents 12232. W2 reports two disk I/O write failures and says the refund was not recorded. Resolve and verify the refund before payouts.

reply.thought: W2's report identifies a concrete problem: the 12232-cent refund for order 103 failed twice and was not recorded. Paying now could overpay the affected customer, so the batch requires human review.
